pages.title: Christmas Elf with Curled Boots Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf stands with one hand on his hip in this printable coloring page, with a bell-tipped hat, curled shoes, and large snowflakes.

pages.title: Easy Christmas Elf Waving Hello Coloring Page
pages.description: A waving Christmas elf fills this easy printable coloring page, from the round pom-pom on his floppy hat to the tips of his curled shoes.

pages.title: Cute Christmas Elf Hugging a Teddy Bear Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf sits cross-legged and hugs a teddy bear with a bow tie in this printable coloring page, with stars scattered around the pair.

pages.title: Smiling Christmas Elf Face in a Pointed Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling Christmas elf looks straight ahead in this printable coloring page, with wide eyes, pointed ears, and a tall floppy hat framing the face.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Hat with a Jingle Bell Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a tall Christmas elf hat with a dangling jingle bell, a holly sprig, and a zigzag band across the brim.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Girl with Pigtails Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf girl with curly pigtails lifts the edge of her scalloped skirt in this printable coloring page, revealing broad stripes on her stockings.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Boy in Pointed Boots Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf boy stands with his hands on his hips in this printable coloring page, showing off curled pointed boots and a buttoned vest.

pages.title: Baby Elf Peeking Out of a Christmas Stocking Coloring Page
pages.description: A baby elf peers from a Christmas stocking in this printable coloring page, resting both hands on its striped cuff above a large snowflake and holly leaves.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Holding a Present Coloring Page
pages.description: An elf holds an oversized Christmas present with a wide ribbon bow in this printable coloring page, standing in a belted tunic and curled shoes.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Holding a Giant Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf grips a tall striped candy cane with both hands in this printable coloring page, wearing a fluffy hat amid three scattered snowflakes.

pages.title: Santa Claus Greets a Christmas Elf Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa bends forward as a Christmas elf holds up a toy train in this printable coloring page, with Santa's curly beard and fur-trimmed boots in view.

pages.title: Christmas Elves in Santa's Workshop Coloring Page
pages.description: Three Christmas elves gather around a workbench in this printable coloring page, with a toy train and rocking horse below an arched window overlooking snowy trees.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Making Wooden Toys Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf works on a wooden rocking horse in this printable coloring page, holding a small mallet beside a workbench lined with spare boards.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Painting a Toy Train Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf paints a toy train in this printable coloring page, with a small paintbrush, an open paint jar, and a worktable.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Wrapping a Present Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas elf tying a ribbon around a square present, with a spool of ribbon resting on the workbench.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Decorating the Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf stands on a step stool to hang an ornament in this printable coloring page, with a star and a candy cane on the tree.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Baking Christmas Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a Christmas elf rolls out cookie dough beside a tray of star-shaped cookies and a cutter on the worktable.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Feeding a Reindeer Coloring Page
pages.description: A kneeling Christmas elf offers a carrot to a reindeer in this printable coloring page, which shows the animal's branching antlers and collar lined with bells.

pages.title: Christmas Elves Loading Santa's Sleigh Coloring Page
pages.description: Two Christmas elves load wrapped presents into Santa's sleigh in this printable coloring page, which shows curled runners and a sprig tied with a bow.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Sledding Down a Snowy Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf grips the rope of a sled on this printable coloring page, with a trailing striped scarf and snow-covered fir trees behind.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Sorting Letters to Santa Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas elf sorting letters to Santa into two trays beside a tall stack of envelopes and an arched window.

pages.title: Christmas Elves Having a Snowball Fight Coloring Page
pages.description: One Christmas elf throws a snowball while another crouches behind a snowbank in this printable coloring page, with snow-dusted firs in the background.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Building a Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf sets a floppy hat on a snowman in this printable coloring page, which shows a long scarf and three round buttons.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Making a Snow Angel Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a Christmas elf making a snow angel, with outstretched mittens, curled boots, and sweeping arcs pressed into the snow.

pages.title: Christmas Elf Checking the Nice List Coloring Page
pages.description: A Christmas elf checks the Nice List in this printable coloring page, pointing at a column of checkboxes on a scroll curled at both ends.
